job.question: In the American Academy of Actuaries' 2011 RFP for retirement plan and related consulting services, what were the plan assets at 12/31/10 of each of its three retirement plans?
job.expected_facts: Money Purchase plan: $3,015,682; 401(k) plan: $1,993,513; Defined Benefit plan: $647,181 (all as of 12/31/10).
job.acceptance: Accept amounts mapped correctly to Money Purchase, 401(k), and Defined Benefit; profit-sharing description is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2021 investment-consultant RFP issued by Arizona’s Public Safety Personnel Retirement System, not the American Academy of Actuaries’ 2011 RFP. It does not provide 12/31/10 assets for the Money Purchase, 401(k), or Defined Benefit plans in the question.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (“RFP”) is issued by the Board of Trustees (“Board”) of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (“System”)
The assets under management for these plans are about $17 billion as of September 10, 2021.
